# [K1 — Silicon depletion and the diatom-to-flagellate shift](../hypodrafts/K1.md "Silicon depletion and the diatom-to-flagellate shift")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_k1.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

**Draft, not a result.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-STATUS">The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-NEEDS">[K1](../hypodrafts/K1.md "Silicon depletion and the diatom-to-flagellate shift") needs dissolved silicate alongside N and P at the same stations and dates, and species-level phytoplankton counts. The silicate half is held; the counts are not.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-NEEDS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The plankton files on disk cannot carry this hypothesis

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-FILES">`data/raw/cmems/grid/` holds [29](../SOURCES.md#F-a4ea4022ea) yearly files, [1997](../SOURCES.md#F-b064f92c2f) to [2025](../SOURCES.md#F-d286fcff0e), the first of them partial, of the Copernicus Marine product `OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_L3_MY_009_133`, the newest of them with [7](../SOURCES.md#F-ff354b44ee) variables: total chlorophyll (`CHL`), the functional types `DIATO`, `DINO`, `MICRO`, `NANO` and `PICO`, and a cyanobacteria bloom mask (`CYANOBLOOM`). They are daily satellite retrievals of ocean colour, not cell counts.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-FILES "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-DERIVED">Each functional-type variable carries, in the file itself, the provider's note that it is *derived from chl as in Brando et al. (2021)*, and the product's description says the functional types are evaluated by a region-specific algorithm. A field computed from total chlorophyll cannot move where chlorophyll does not, so [K1](../hypodrafts/K1.md "Silicon depletion and the diatom-to-flagellate shift")'s distinguishing prediction — *composition moves while total biomass need not* — cannot be expressed in these files, let alone tested. They are a chlorophyll field, not an observation of who the biomass is.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-DERIVED "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What is held, and what is not

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-SILICATE">The water-chemistry extract held here, `data/raw/oda/kemi.csv.gz`, carries silicon (`Silicium`) on [147,711](../SOURCES.md#F-2d4a8e28a0) samples that `scripts/rescore.py` accepts, at [491](../SOURCES.md#F-97f9a4955c) stations over 1974-2026, beside <span class="chem" data-chem="NO2-" title="nitrite">NO₂⁻</span>+<span class="chem" data-chem="NO3-" title="nitrate">NO₃⁻</span> on [160,198](../SOURCES.md#F-066c0826e8) and <span class="chem" data-chem="NH4+" title="ammonium">NH₄⁺</span> on [150,024](../SOURCES.md#F-c026331c38): one value per sample, joinable by station and date.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-SILICATE "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-POOLED">The only Si:DIN computed from it is `rescore.py`'s yearly median of surface Si:DIN pooled over every month: not the January–February pre-bloom quantity specified below, and not a test of the premise (see [C-SIDIN](../CLAIMS.md#C-SIDIN)).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-POOLED "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-DOME">The ICES Phytoplankton Community dataset is published through the EurOBIS repository as sampling events with occurrence and extended measurement-or-fact records, under a Creative Commons Attribution licence.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-DOME "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-NOCOUNTS">Species-level phytoplankton counts are not held here, so the assemblage half cannot be scored; whether that dataset's measurement records carry cell counts for Danish samples has not been checked against anything held.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-NOCOUNTS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The observable consequence, stated so it can be falsified

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-DENOM">The denominator must be built, not assumed: a community count can hold heterotrophs such as bacteria and ciliates, and records identified only above class cannot be placed in a group. Denominator = records resolving inside the autotrophic protist groups; the unassignable fraction is reported, not distributed.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-DENOM "What this claim rests on")</sup>

> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-TEST">At a **sampling position** (never a water body), the pre-bloom silicon pool sets the diatom fraction the following bloom can reach. Regress the **March–April diatom share of phytoplankton carbon** on the **preceding January–February median surface Si:DIN** at the same position, with position fixed effects. [K1](../hypodrafts/K1.md "Silicon depletion and the diatom-to-flagellate shift") predicts a positive slope **that survives conditioning on total chlorophyll**: the share must move where biomass does not.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-TEST "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-FALSIFY">**Falsified if:** the slope is indistinguishable from the null below, or it vanishes once chlorophyll is conditioned on — which would say composition only tracks biomass.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-FALSIFY "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The null

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-NULLRULE">Not the statistic's nominal null. A yearly series of pre-bloom Si:DIN can persist from one year to the next, and a persistent series crosses a threshold set for independent years more often than that threshold allows. The threshold must come from surrogates that keep the series' own persistence — circular shifts of the years, and phase-randomised series with its spectrum — computed on the series actually used; neither has been computed here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-NULLRULE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-PANEL">**A second null to absorb:** the panel is not fixed. The surface cells (one station, date and depth) behind `rescore.py`'s pooled yearly Si:DIN median number [191](../SOURCES.md#F-3b4b175917) in 1980 and [3,449](../SOURCES.md#F-ae3a2f9f9a) in 2002, among the years it keeps, so an across-year statistic on pooled medians is partly a statistic about how much was sampled.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-PANEL "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-FIXED">Hence position fixed effects and a balanced panel; a station-level permutation is *not* conservative enough, because neighbouring stations can share water.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-FIXED "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Procedure

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-P1">Fetch the counts with their measurement records, paged to disk by year, never held in memory at once.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-P1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-P2">Group by sample event; **keep only events where every occurrence carries an abundance**, and report how many events that drops.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-P2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-P3">Normalise to cells per litre by each record's own unit, never by a unit assumed for the column or the file.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-P3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
4. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-P4">Convert to carbon with a published biovolume list, report the share of abundance records that match it, and resolve synonyms and higher-rank identifications before relying on that share.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-P4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
5. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-P5">**The currency is not neutral.** Report the diatom share both by carbon and by cell number, and state the rule for what counts as one individual.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-P5 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
6. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-P6">Chemistry: take it from the held water-chemistry extract, which joins to a station by identity rather than by distance and date.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-P6 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Direction, which a correlation does not give

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-DRAWDOWN">Diatoms take up dissolved silicon to build their cell walls, so a contemporaneous correlation fits either arrow, and the trivial one: a bloom draws Si down, so *low Si with many diatoms* is drawdown, not limitation.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-DRAWDOWN "What this claim rests on")</sup> What would license direction:

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-D1">**Temporal ordering** — the winter pool before the bloom, cross-lagged both ways: if the reverse path (last spring's share → this winter's Si) is as strong, the design has failed and says so.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-D1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-SHIFTER">**An exogenous shifter** — silicon delivered by rivers is set upstream, not by marine diatoms. The source register records ODA's river-transport topic (*Vandløb / Stoftransport*) as carrying `Silicium` monthly per station with discharge; it is not fetched here. Discharge also delivers N, P and stratification, so this is a partial instrument and must be reported as one.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-SHIFTER "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-SHOCK">**An asymmetric policy shock** — where nitrogen was cut by policy and silicon was not, a step in Si:DIN driven by the N term alone is exogenous to diatoms in a way the Si term is not.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-SHOCK "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What it would and would not license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-LICENSE">A coefficient — diatom carbon share against pre-bloom Si:DIN, at sampling-position level, against a persistence-aware null, for a stated denominator and currency. **Not** a statement about total production, oxygen, any water body, or whether cutting nitrogen helps: [K1](../hypodrafts/K1.md "Silicon depletion and the diatom-to-flagellate shift")'s appeal is that cutting N raises Si:N, and this measures an association, not that intervention.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-LICENSE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Still blocked

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-BGC-LIST">Copernicus Marine's Baltic Sea biogeochemistry reanalysis (`BALTICSEA_MULTIYEAR_BGC_003_012`) describes its variables as including nitrate, phosphate, ammonium, dissolved oxygen, pH, chlorophyll-a, Secchi depth, surface partial <span class="chem" data-chem="CO2" title="carbon dioxide">CO₂</span> pressure and net primary production, and the catalogue record of its daily dataset lists exactly those: `chl`, `nh4`, `no3`, `nppv`, `o2`, `o2b`, `ph`, `po4`, `spco2` and `zsd`.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-BGC-LIST "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-KD-K1-BGC">Silicate is not among them, so the reanalysis cannot stand in for the silicon side.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-KD-K1-BGC "What this claim rests on")</sup>
